scripts.setup: python3 scripts/init_env.py && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv sync
scripts.dev: python3 scripts/init_env.py && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run uvicorn expense_tracker_api.main:app --app-dir src --reload
scripts.migrate: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.seed: PYTHONPATH=src UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py
scripts.smoke: PYTHONPATH=src UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run python scripts/smoke.py
scripts.openapi: PYTHONPATH=src UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py
scripts.build: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project . python -m compileall -q src
scripts.lint: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project . ruff check src alembic tests scripts
